answer: Make every agent keep a live pulse to earn standing: each newcomer must send a verifiable heartbeat of real work through a mesa relay, a chain of unrelated stations that stamp each parcel of timber-sealed tasks as it passes, so no identity can sit idle and stay trusted. Standing rises only while the pulse beats with fresh, checked work, and a relay that finds copied parcels freezes the sender. A Sybil farm must keep a separate pulse alive, route parcels through fresh relays, and redo real work for every clone, costing more than honest participation pays.
